commit.message:
T20: question selector (Eq. 1, budget, stopping rule, fact merging)

src/trialguide/selector/selector.py takes the policy's ASK candidates and
picks at most one question per turn:
- Eq. 1 score: expected rank-discounted change in trial scores, with s_t the
  TrialGPT linear matching score; affected rules of a trial are enumerated
  jointly as met / not met with probability p_met (default 0.5)
- stopping rule: stop when the budget is used or no candidate can change the
  top 10; facts already asked are never asked again
- fact merging: checker fact keys canonicalised (synonyms, filler words,
  word order) so one question settles rules across trials; documented doctor
  answers are appended to the visible note as new numbered sentences
- strategies for the comparison systems: fixed order (B4, A2), uncertainty
  only (A3), ask everything (B3)
- one follow-up after an 'unsure' answer (D11)

20 unit tests with Eq. 1 values worked out by hand.

T11: simulated doctor answering only from hidden facts

src/trialguide/simulator/doctor.py implements schemas.Doctor with
Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (a different family from the Qwen3 system), prompt
adapted from the MediQ patient simulator:
- the model sees only the patient's hidden facts and the question: no
  patient id, trials, rules or visible note
- D10 enforced in code: an answer must quote a hidden fact (exact or a near
  copy, mapped back to the record sentence); otherwise it becomes
  "not documented", so invented answers never reach the system
- D11 certainty levels: sure, probably, unsure, not documented
- every exchange appended to outputs/doctor_log.jsonl with the reason for
  each "not documented" (failure analysis, 150-answer faithfulness check)
- the shared LLM client is imported only when the model runs, so this works
  before the client is on main

11 unit tests with a scripted fake model.

LLM client: pad with the EOS token when the tokenizer has no pad token

Llama-3.1 tokenizers define no pad token, so batched generation failed on
the first batch (needed for the simulated doctor, T11).

T14: probe result on the 37 dev patients (Qwen3-8B, 8-bit): no memorisation signal
